say:2:1711068001:1.text: You and Evie recount everything you discovered inside Cyran's hidden chamber, especially everything connected to dark magic.
say:2:1711068001:1.source_cn: 你和伊芙详细讲述了在迪尔格雷密室里的发现，尤其是禁术相...
say:2:1711068001:1.male: You and Evie recount everything you discovered inside Cyran's hidden chamber, especially everything connected to dark magic.
say:2:1711068001:1.female: You and Evie recount everything you discovered inside Cyran's hidden chamber, especially everything connected to dark magic.

say:3:1711068002:1.text: Your Majesty, our investigation confirms that Cyran achieved a genuine breakthrough.
say:3:1711068002:1.source_cn: 陛下，根据我们的调查，迪尔格雷的禁术研究确实取得了突破。

say:4:1711068003:1.text: Although using the spell still comes with a price, in theory, that cost can be forcibly transferred onto a third party without their consent.
say:4:1711068003:1.source_cn: 虽然施展禁术依然需要付出代价，但理论上，这个代价可以在...

say:5:1711068004:1.text: Which means... if we find a suitable vessel—a death-row inmate, perhaps—we could attempt to transfer the cost required to heal the King.
say:5:1711068004:1.source_cn: 这意味着……如果我们能找到合适的载体——比如死刑犯，就...

say:6:1711068005:1.text: Enough, Evie. The laws of the empire do not permit unlawful execution, let alone the use of a living human as a sacrifice.
say:6:1711068005:1.source_cn: 住口，伊芙。耀光的法律绝不允许滥用私刑，更不允许将活人...

say:7:1711068006:1.text: ... But this is different. This is to save the King.
say:7:1711068006:1.source_cn: ……但这不一样，这是为了救国王陛下。

say:8:1711068007:1.text: It is no different. Maximilian would never allow it. If the price of his life is the trampling of the law and the sacrifice of another, he would rather never wake up.
say:8:1711068007:1.source_cn: 没有什么不一样。马克西姆也不会允许这种做法。若是为了苟...

say:9:1711068008:1.text: ... Fine. Even if you insist on upholding your principles, I still can't let you bear that cost yourself!
say:9:1711068008:1.source_cn: ……好，就算您坚持原则，但我依然反对由您亲自承受代价！

say:10:1711068009:1.text: If something happens to you, what happens to the empire that only just regained stability? What happens to Princess Peggy?!
say:10:1711068009:1.source_cn: 您要是出了事，让刚刚稳定下来的耀光怎么办？让佩吉公主怎么办！

choice_prompt:11:1711068009.text: If something happens to you, what happens to the empire that only just regained stability? What happens to Princess Peggy?!
choice_prompt:11:1711068009.source_cn: 您要是出了事，让刚刚稳定下来的耀光怎么办？让佩吉公主怎么办！

say:12:1711068010:1.text: You remind her that as the Queen of the Lightbearer Empire, her safety is tied to the fate of countless lives.
say:12:1711068010:1.source_cn: 你提醒她，身为耀光的王后，她的安危同样身系无数人的命运。
say:12:1711068010:1.male: You remind her that as the Queen of the Lightbearer Empire, her safety is tied to the fate of countless lives.
say:12:1711068010:1.female: You remind her that as the Queen of the Lightbearer Empire, her safety is tied to the fate of countless lives.

say:13:1711068011:1.text: Merlin, Evie... I am firm in this, not just out of a wife's devotion, but it is also my duty as queen.
say:13:1711068011:1.source_cn: 梅林，伊芙，我坚持这么做，不仅仅是出于妻子的私心，也是...
say:13:1711068011:1.male: Merlin, Evie... I am firm in this, not just out of a wife's devotion, but it is also my duty as queen.
say:13:1711068011:1.female: Merlin, Evie... I am firm in this, not just out of a wife's devotion, but it is also my duty as queen.

say:14:1711068012:1.text: The empire needs its king. The political landscape needs stability. That is my duty. And I... I need my husband. That is my heart.
say:14:1711068012:1.source_cn: 耀光需要它的国王，政局需要稳定，这是公心。而我……我需...

say:15:1711068013:1.text: I once watched him take his oath under the Savannah sun, so full of life. And now all I can do is watch him waste away on that bed.
say:15:1711068013:1.source_cn: 我曾看着他意气风发地在赛凡纳的阳光下宣誓，如今却只能看...

say:16:1711068014:1.text: Watching life fade from the one you love... that pain is far worse than any backlash forbidden magic could inflict.
say:16:1711068014:1.source_cn: 眼睁睁看着爱人的生命走向消亡，这种折磨，比任何禁术的反...

say:17:1711068015:1.text: But Your Majesty... doesn't the King feel the same for you? He wouldn't want to wake up knowing the risk you took.
say:17:1711068015:1.source_cn: 可是陛下……国王对您不也怀着同样的感情吗？他也不愿看到...

say:18:1711068016:1.text: If he wakes up and finds out what you sacrificed... how could he live with himself?
say:18:1711068016:1.source_cn: 当他醒来，发现您付出了这种代价……他又该如何自处？

say:19:1711068017:1.text: I cannot afford to care about that anymore. Both I and this empire need him awake... regardless of what it costs me.
say:19:1711068017:1.source_cn: 但我顾不了那么多了。我和耀光都需要他尽快醒来……无论需...

choice_prompt:20:1711068017.text: I cannot afford to care about that anymore. Both I and this empire need him awake... regardless of what it costs me.
choice_prompt:20:1711068017.source_cn: 但我顾不了那么多了。我和耀光都需要他尽快醒来……无论需要我付出什么。

say:21:1711068018:1.text: If the worst should happen, I will accept it.
say:21:1711068018:1.source_cn: 如果不幸发生，我会坦然接受。
say:21:1711068018:1.male: If the worst should happen, I will accept it.
say:21:1711068018:1.female: If the worst should happen, I will accept it.

say:22:1711068019:1.text: But... Merlin, with you by my side, I truly believe it won't come to that. Am I wrong?
say:22:1711068019:1.source_cn: 但是……梅林，既然有你在我身边，我相信事情不会走到那一...
say:22:1711068019:1.male: But... Merlin, with you by my side, I truly believe it won't come to that. Am I wrong?
say:22:1711068019:1.female: But... Merlin, with you by my side, I truly believe it won't come to that. Am I wrong?

say:23:1711068020:1.text: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.
say:23:1711068020:1.source_cn: 你是当世最伟大的魔法师，你一定不会眼睁睁看着我出事的。
say:23:1711068020:1.male: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.
say:23:1711068020:1.female: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.

choice_prompt:24:1711068020.text: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.
choice_prompt:24:1711068020.source_cn: 你是当世最伟大的魔法师，你一定不会眼睁睁看着我出事的。
choice_prompt:24:1711068020.male: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.
choice_prompt:24:1711068020.female: You are the greatest mage of this era. I know you won't just stand there and let something happen to me.

say:25:1711068021:1.text: I'm not trying to pressure you. I'm just telling you how much I trust you.
say:25:1711068021:1.source_cn: 我没有在逼迫你，梅林。我只是在陈述我对你的信任。
say:25:1711068021:1.male: I'm not trying to pressure you. I'm just telling you how much I trust you.
say:25:1711068021:1.female: I'm not trying to pressure you. I'm just telling you how much I trust you.

say:26:1711068022:1.text: You sigh, looking her in the eye as you draw your line in the sand.
say:26:1711068022:1.source_cn: 你叹了口气，看着她的眼睛，给出了你的底线。
say:26:1711068022:1.male: You sigh, looking her in the eye as you draw your line in the sand.
say:26:1711068022:1.female: You sigh, looking her in the eye as you draw your line in the sand.

say:27:1711068023:1.text: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.
say:27:1711068023:1.source_cn: 你告诉莫德琳，如果有办法的话，你会救马克西姆。但你绝不...
say:27:1711068023:1.male: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.
say:27:1711068023:1.female: You tell Gwendolyn that if there's a way, you will save Maximilian. But you will never use the kind of dark magic Cyran relied on—magic built on plunder and sacrifice.

say:28:1711068024:1.text: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.
say:28:1711068024:1.source_cn: 我就知道你会这么说。如果你刚才一口答应，那才不是我认识...
say:28:1711068024:1.male: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.
say:28:1711068024:1.female: I knew you would say that. If you had agreed immediately, you wouldn't be the Merlin I know.

say:29:1711068025:1.text: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—
say:29:1711068025:1.source_cn: 既然我们都否决了迪尔格雷的方案，那就只剩下一条路了——
say:29:1711068025:1.male: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—
say:29:1711068025:1.female: Since we've both rejected Cyran's method, that leaves only one path—

say:30:1711068026:1.text: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
say:30:1711068026:1.source_cn: 我们自己来，我们来改良禁术。
say:30:1711068026:1.male: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
say:30:1711068026:1.female: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.

choice_prompt:31:1711068026.text: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.source_cn: 我们自己来，我们来改良禁术。
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.male: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.
choice_prompt:31:1711068026.female: We'll do it ourselves and refine the dark magic.

say:32:1711068027:1.text: Then let us collaborate once more.
say:32:1711068027:1.source_cn: 好！那就让我们再合作一次吧，梅林。
say:32:1711068027:1.male: Then let us collaborate once more.
say:32:1711068027:1.female: Then let us collaborate once more.

say:33:1711068028:1.text: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.
say:33:1711068028:1.source_cn: 这让我想起了二十多年前……那时候我们也是为了攻克一个魔...
say:33:1711068028:1.male: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.
say:33:1711068028:1.female: This reminds me of twenty years ago... back when we would spend whole nights arguing, experimenting, and calculating to crack a magical theory.

say:34:1711068029:1.text: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.
say:34:1711068029:1.source_cn: 虽然因为失忆，你可能已经不记得那些日子了，但没关系……...
say:34:1711068029:1.male: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.
say:34:1711068029:1.female: You may not remember because of your amnesia, but it doesn't matter. We can make new memories.

say:35:1711068030:1.text: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.
say:35:1711068030:1.source_cn: 顺便，我们打个赌如何？看谁能最快解析出那个法阵的改良版……
say:35:1711068030:1.male: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.
say:35:1711068030:1.female: In fact, shall we make a wager? Let's see who can first devise a stable, refined version of that array.

say:36:1711068031:1.text: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
say:36:1711068031:1.source_cn: 如果谁输了，可是要答应对方一个条件的。
say:36:1711068031:1.male: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
say:36:1711068031:1.female: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.

choice_prompt:37:1711068031.text: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.source_cn: 如果谁输了，可是要答应对方一个条件的。
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.male: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.
choice_prompt:37:1711068031.female: And whoever loses must grant the winner one request.

say:38:1711068032:1.text: In that case, I'll be the witness!
say:38:1711068032:1.source_cn: 既然如此，那就由我来做见证人！

say:39:1711068033:1.text: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.
say:39:1711068033:1.source_cn: 那就从现在开始，看看谁才是最终的胜者。
say:39:1711068033:1.male: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.
say:39:1711068033:1.female: Then let us begin, and see who claims victory in the end.

say:40:1711068034:1.text: This time, I won't lose to you.
say:40:1711068034:1.source_cn: 梅林，这一次，我可不会再输给你。
say:40:1711068034:1.male: This time, I won't lose to you.
say:40:1711068034:1.female: This time, I won't lose to you.

narration:41:1711068035:1.text: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.
narration:41:1711068035:1.male: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.
narration:41:1711068035:1.female: With the wager made, the two of you throw yourselves into your research. In the days that follow, the Royal Library and the Mystical House remain illuminated deep into the night.

narration:42:1711068036:1.text: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...
narration:42:1711068036:1.male: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...
narration:42:1711068036:1.female: Cyran's papers are dismantled and analyzed piece by piece, as you attempt to reconstruct a path to life from the twisted circuits of the dark magic...

choice:37:1:2.text: No backing out when you lose.
choice:37:1:2.male: No backing out when you lose.
choice:37:1:2.female: No backing out when you lose.

choice:31:1:2.text: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.
choice:31:1:2.source_cn: 相信我，我比迪尔格雷更强
choice:31:1:2.male: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.
choice:31:1:2.female: Anything Cyran does, I can do better.

choice:24:1:2.text: I won't help you use dark magic.
choice:24:1:2.source_cn: 我不会协助你使用黑魔法
choice:24:1:2.male: I won't help you use dark magic.
choice:24:1:2.female: I won't help you use dark magic.

choice:20:0:1.text: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?
choice:20:0:1.source_cn: 哪怕是折损寿命，甚至失去生命吗？
choice:20:0:1.male: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?
choice:20:0:1.female: Even if it costs you your lifespan? Even your life?

choice:11:1:2.text: There are countless people who still need you.
choice:11:1:2.male: There are countless people who still need you.
choice:11:1:2.female: There are countless people who still need you.
